title: Final convergence review
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — Two new findings: one P0 correctness bug (misleading error variant on KARI unsupported algorithm path), one P1 API-lock-in (KariAlgorithm missing non_exhaustive). No security issues. No new maintainability or documentation concerns.
Idiom rating: CLEAN — No new ownership, error handling, iterator, type design, trait, lifetime, or unsafe findings. The two prior-pass expect() calls in production code have provable safety invariants documented in comments. No clippy-level issues. The codebase is idiomatically consistent with RustCrypto conventions.
Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: KARI path in general (only RSA decrypt path has a real-message OpenSSL oracle; KARI round-trip has no integration test). Uncertainty driven by: no KARI-path integration test against an external oracle. Would raise confidence if: an OpenSSL KARI encrypt + smime-tree decrypt integration test were added.
Rust idiom confidence: 5% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: none. Uncertainty driven by: pre-release dependency versions (all major deps are RCs) could have subtle API behavior differences from final releases.
